observations.body: The scene includes the Son’s eyes and feet, works, and love. It also includes service, endurance, and Jezebel. It also includes teaching, repentance, and judgment. It also includes hearts, works, and deep things. It also includes authority, morning star, and hearing. Together, these details unfold through the passage.
